title: Varying Payload Representations in Parallel API Operations
pattern: Exposing multiple methods for the same business operation, each accepting a different serialization format or input model.
why_bad: It clutters the API surface and pushes serialization responsibility down into the business logic. It violates design consistency and makes testing, versioning, and security audits extremely difficult.
detection: Flag service classes that expose multiple methods performing the same logical task but taking different raw inputs (like strings, byte arrays, and objects) in parallel.
counterexample: Low-level serialization libraries designed specifically for multi-format decoding. Marked `Context-dependent`.
fix: Standardize the service signature on a single, uniform type (e.g., `AlbumDto`) and let outer controller adapters handle the parsing.
source: *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* by Martin Fowler (2002), p. 388, 747.
